Heard Mr. Dhananjay Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioner, Ms. Shweta, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the complainant as well as Mr. Abhay Kumar Roy, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1159 of 2021 for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323 and 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the D.P. Act.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has clean antecedent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

He further submits that as per the allegation in the complaint petition, the complainant was ousted Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.33376 of 2023(3)
dt.16-10-2023 from her matrimonial house due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry of Rs. 3 lakh.

He further submits that the allegation as alleged in the complaint petition is false and fabricated and the petitioner has not committed any offences as alleged in the complaint petition and the petitioner Raushan Kumar Sah @ Raushan Kumar @ ... vs The State Of Bihar on 16 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47353887/
1 has never demanded any dowry from the family member of the complainant and he is ready to keep the complainant has his wife with full honor and dignity.
4. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the complainant as well as learned A.P.P for the State on the other hand vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and submits that the complainant did not want to live with the petitioner and she want one time settlement.
5.

sentences.text: In view of the aforesaid, let the petitioner and the informant physically appear before the District Mediation Centre, Banka on 31.10.2023.
6. The learned District and Sessions Judge, Banka is directed to obtain the report of the learned District Mediation Centre and transmit to this Court.
The report of the learned mediator must reach to this Court within a period of three months.
7. In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.33376 of 2023(3) dt.16-10-2023 against the petitioner.

8. Re-notify after three months along with the report of the learned Mediator.
(Rajesh Kumar Verma, J) Vanisha/-
